EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 27(1) of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, I, A. Ibathul Rauff Hakeem,Minister of City Planning, Water Supply and Higher Education, on the recommendation of the University Grants Commission,do by this Order, amend the Schedule to the Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 1448/27 of June 09, 2006 (as lastamended by Order published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2113/62 of March 08, 2019), which specifies the Faculties andDepartments of the University of Colombo, Sri Lanka, which is deemed, by virtue of the provisions of section 139 of aforesaidAct, to be a University established under Section 21 of the said Act, by the substituion for the item “Faculty of Medicine”appearing in Column I and its corresponding entries in Column II thereof, of the following :-

Faculty of Medicine1.Department of Anatomy2.Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology3.Department of Community Medicine4.Department of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology5.Department of Clinical Medicine6.Department of Microbiology7.Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology8.Department of Paediatrics
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
